item.title: Some Ways to Enhance Your WSL Experience
item.author: komorebi2333@gmail.com (komorebi)
item.description:
This article provides tips to help frequent WSL users improve their experience and efficiency. This article will not cover the installation of WSL, you can refer to the official documentation if you need it. BTW I prefer to use the WSL2 + ArchWSL

Open wsl folders with Windows Explorer

Sometimes, we need to open files in WSL using Windows File Explorer. Normally, we can manually access Windows File Explorer and type \\wsl$ in the address bar to navigate to WSL. However, if we want to quickly open a WSL directory from the command line (similar to how we use code + directory with VS Code’s WSL Remote), we can achieve this by writing an executable script.
